personal.support: Subject/object forms are distinguished; object form follows the verb or preposition. Referent judgments here retain explicit information supplied by the question.

relative.support: Defining clauses identify the noun; who/that can refer to people and which/that to things. Separating the modifying clause leaves the stated main clause; plural agreement reuses previously read BC be table.

object-omission.support: In the stated defining clauses the object relative pronoun may be omitted; a subject gap cannot be replaced by simply dropping the linker, nor duplicated with it.
